title: Layer chain
description: Layer-chain shape rules: ordered single-key objects, outermost (L2) first. Chain semantics (completion, inference, per-field values) are owned by Go (layers.ValidateLayers); per-layer field tables come from generated/layers.generated.json (registry dump, never hand-written). Layer fields accept a scalar (static) or a dynamic_value object (per-flow dynamic) on the allowlisted four-tuple-ish fields (ip.src/ip.dst, tcp/udp src_port/dst_port, eth src_mac/dst_mac, ip.ttl); other fields take scalars only. Flat four-tuple keys alongside layers are rejected.
